findings: All twelve exact sources were read. Each actual capacity-list cell saves its current binary counter representation and invokes the real increment program. Two nil allocations initialize zero and the accumulator; no vertex words are supplied.

The actual reversed scan output is handed to the six-slot list reversal on the same heap. Its copied spine retains original word roots. The 44-slot caller returns the original-order generated words, including empty input, with the explicit quadratic instruction bound.

Numeric labels and their widths are derived by induction from the actual increment specification. Mapping finRange through the generated-label definition gives the same returned list, rather than a separately supplied enumeration.

The 8420-slot caller saves the original capacity, matrix and demand roots, receives the actual generated list in r1, and calls the previously reviewed primitive-input solver on that same heap. Derived label width n and capacity width B are combined as B+n. The final output is the literal original solveInput six-field state and event representation.

Both physical wrappers refine the same natural run and include terminal-attempt accounting, original source/stack retention and heap-prefix preservation. Their bounds use original capacity length, demand count, capacity width and initial heap/address bounds.

Eight standalone physical generator cases and two full physical solver cases are distinguished from the two larger natural-reference solver cases. Fixture outputs compare all original state/event fields; the generator compares numeric words in ascending order.
qualifications: The full solver assumes positive graph order, primitive capacity and adjacency representations, and demand records encoded using the internally generated label family. No supplied vertex list, numeric-label certificate or label-width bound remains.

Primitive capacity/adjacency construction, demand preparation, outer degenerate dispatch and the full paper runtime remain separate. Integration, replays and terminal exact CI require their own evidence.
